entities.summary: Habiba Sayeed Alsafar is an Emirati geneticist, biomedical engineer and academic. She is a Professor of Biomedical Engineering & Biotechnology at Khalifa University and is the Dean of College of Medicine and Health Sciences and Director of the Khalifa University Biotechnology Center.
